newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bund futures surge in late trade, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Bund futures surge in late trade, more gains seen.

text.p: Bund futures surged by around a third of a point on Tuesday as U.S. inflation figures and a benign domestic economic picture spured professional demand.
Traders said the gains, which pushed Bunds above the psychologically important 101.00 level, appeared to put the market back on an upward course after losses in recent weeks.
At 1526 GMT, the DTB March Bund future was up 30 basis points at 101.15. The cash bond was also higher at 101.62 from 101.32, yielding 5.78 percent.
The big boost came when Treasuries advanced after core U.S. CPI climbed 0.1 pct in December, below expectations.
Bunds, as was to be expected, underperformed their U.S. counterparts after the favourable U.S. inflation report.
The spread between Bunds and T-notes narrowed to 87 basis points from around 90 basis points at the previous close.
Analysts said the spread, which is now at the top end of a range that dominated much of last year, might not grow much further.
Although German fundamentals are bond-market friendly, today's U.S. inflation report and speculation of slower U.S. growth this year should also help Treasuries.

A speech by Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert did little to change Germany's interest rate picture. Sievert said he saw no grounds for higher interest rates and there was no need to cut rates at present.
"Whether there is room to manoeuvre on the downside remains to be seen," he added.
Both remarks were in line with the bond market's expectations.
The German yield curve, meanwhile, flattened by one basis point on Tuesday as the spread between two- and 10-year maturities stood at 248 basis points.
Most of the flattening took place on the short-end of the curve between two- and five year maturities, suggesting that the market may still be hoping for a cut in the repo rate.
Otherwise, traders said the rebound in Treasuries has removed one roadblock to further gains and that the technical picture improved on the day with the contract advancing as high as 101.27.
